gradcam.target: class predicted by the external-fold model
gradcam.target_layer: last convolutional ReLU, before fourth max pooling

deletion.random_control: one deterministic equal-area random mask per prediction

channel_ablation.metric: change in confidence of the originally predicted class

weight_randomization_sanity.scope: one deterministically selected external image per each of 200 checkpoints
weight_randomization_sanity.comparison: trained Grad-CAM versus fully reinitialized model Grad-CAM

aggregation.primary_unit: participant after averaging the five repeated external predictions

interpretation: diagnostic explanation of this frozen low-performing CNN; no clinical attribution
